answer: Lease one tidal fish weir for 120 days. A 150 token deposit locks and a 90 dollar license names the keeper, who checks 20 numbered traps from a bridge at dawn. The catch is weighed by the bridge while a neighbor signs the tally, and a falcon box is photographed weekly to prove the keeper was on site. An inspector visits twice to match the tally against trap counts. A forged tally forfeits the deposit and bars the keeper 180 days. Faking 10,000 weirs freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 900,000 dollars. Like a fisherman racing the tide, a fake keeper cannot stand on ten bridges at dawn.
